evidence.reason: The build wrapper forwards only SIGINT and SIGTERM to the spawned child. Node terminates on SIGHUP by default, so a SIGHUP sent directly to the build PID exits the wrapper while the non-detached child keeps running and can still write dist after the wrapper exits; markBuildComplete is also skipped. Adding SIGHUP to the same forwarded-signal list is a minimal ordinary correctness fix, not a new contract requirement.
